title: dKV Forcing: Separating Generation and Memory Representations through a Differentiable KV Cache
abstract: arXiv:2611.01648v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A causal video generator writes every segment it produces into a key--value (KV) cache, and later segments know the past only through it. Self-rollout training stops the gradient at this cache, and Self Gradient Forcing (SGF) restores it, but applies it to the same weights that generate the current segment. We find that writing and generating are different roles: in a pretrained generator the written KV already differs from the KV used for denoising, and on shared weights the gradient from future reads is negatively aligned with the gradient of generation. We propose dKV Forcing (dKV denotes differentiable KV), which gives the write its own parameters, a low-rank residual used only when a segment enters the cache, and trains them with the gradient of the later segments that read what they wrote. Opening this gradient through the cache in common use exhausts GPU memory. We trace this to checkpoint replay re-writing the cache, no

translated_title: dKV Forcing：通过可微KV缓存分离生成与记忆表征
translated_abstract: 自回归视频生成器会将其生成的每个片段写入键值（KV）缓存，而后续片段只能通过该缓存了解过去。自回放训练在缓存处截断了梯度，而自梯度强制（SGF）恢复了这一梯度，但将其应用于生成当前片段的同一组权重上。我们发现写入与生成是两种不同的角色：在预训练生成器中，写入的KV已经与用于去噪的KV存在差异，并且在共享权重的情况下，来自未来读取的梯度与生成梯度呈负对齐。我们提出dKV Forcing（dKV表示可微KV），为写入操作赋予其独立的参数——一个仅在片段进入缓存时启用的低秩残差——并利用后续读取其所写内容的片段的梯度来训练这些参数。在常见使用场景下，通过缓存打开这一梯度会耗尽GPU内存。我们将其归因于检查点重放对缓存的重写……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出dKV Forcing方法，为KV缓存写入分配独立的低秩残差参数，实现生成与记忆表征的解耦，并利用后续片段读取的梯度来优化缓存写入，从而改进自回归视频生成器的训练。
en_tdlr: dKV Forcing decouples generation and memory representations in causal video generators by assigning dedicated low-rank residual parameters to KV cache writes, trained through gradients from future segments that read those writes.
